suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-14 adds this relationship only as the user-approved bounded clinical proposition. A meta-analysis of surgery for bilateral multinodular nontoxic goiter found increased transient postoperative hypoparathyroidism after total thyroidectomy; the approved relationship is treatment-mediated and does not extend to permanent hypoparathyroidism or to thyroid enlargement without surgery. Require multinodular nontoxic thyroid enlargement plus documented total or near-total thyroid surgery followed by separately documented postoperative hypoparathyroidism. The supported proposition is transient postoperative hypoparathyroidism; do not infer permanent hypoparathyroidism, and do not infer hypoparathyroidism from the thyroid enlargement itself. Preserve other neck surgery, autoimmune or genetic parathyroid disease, magnesium disorders, and other etiologies as competing explanations. The cited literature supports only this constrained proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
